item.tib: mkha' 'gro gsang gcod kyi dmigs skor las yan lag gi gcod bzhi'i lag len snying thig ma
item.coloph: 'di nas gzhung la bsdus pa tsam du 'dug pas/ bdag gis cung zad spros pa yin te/ mi 'thad 'gal bar gyur srid na/ ltang (stangs) 'dzin dam can rnams la bshags/ legs pa'i yon tan gang smin pa/ 'gro ba kun la phan thog shog de ltar yan lag gcod bzhi'i lag len/ rkyang (skyang) sprul nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis phyes pa'o//
